name: Campingplatz Maier Schwoich
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Maier in Schwoich is idyllically situated in the Tiroler Unterland, between Kufstein and the wildly romantic Kaisergebirge. The spacious, park-like grounds offer a magnificent view of the surrounding mountain scenery and are located very close to several swimming lakes. The campsite's modern amenities include spacious pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents, a heated outdoor pool and a wellness area. The on-site restaurant spoils guests with regional Tiroler cuisine, while a children's playground provides entertainment. The peaceful, family-friendly atmosphere makes the campsite an ideal destination for those seeking relaxation. It caters to nature-loving families and active holidaymakers who want to explore the hiking and cycling trails of the region
